# Mount Logan Capital Inc. Completes Merger of the Alternative Credit Income Fund with BC Partners Lending Corporation


October 14, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_7ced27890602683e7bb644454401dd00/mountlogancapital/news/2026-10-14_Mount_Logan_Capital_Inc_Completes_Merger_of_the_127.pdf)


***Merger is expected to be immediately accretive to Mount Logan's FRE*** ***1*** ***and EPS, with benefits beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026***


***Together with the recently completed Yieldstreet transaction, expected to contribute more than $6.5 million to FRE in 2027***


NEW YORK, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Mount Logan Capital Inc. (Nasdaq: MLCI) (“Mount Logan” or the “Company”) today announced the completion of the merger of the Alternative Credit Income Fund (“ACIF”) with BC Partners Lending Corporation (“BCPL”), a private business development company focused on direct lending (the “Merger”). The Merger was approved by holders of a majority of the outstanding shares of ACIF on September 10, 2026, and closed on September 29, 2026. Following completion of the transaction, ACIF shareholders received shares of BCPL in accordance with the terms of the merger agreement.


The Merger moves ACIF shareholders into BCPL, a larger and more traditional direct lending vehicle, consolidating into a single operating platform designed to deliver a better outcome for ACIF's underlying investors through greater scale and more diversified portfolio. For Mount Logan, the Merger is the latest step in Mount Logan's ongoing effort to simplify its managed-fund platform and concentrate platform resources on its largest fee-generating vehicles.


Mount Logan expects the Merger to increase the Company’s net Fee-Related Earnings (“FRE”) by approximately $3.5 million on an annualized basis. The benefit is primarily driven by two components. First, the elimination of operating costs and infrastructure associated with supporting ACIF as a standalone vehicle with these benefits expected to be partially offset by the loss of interest income associated with company’s promissory note that was issued on October 30, 2020. Secondly, the Merger includes a revenue-sharing agreement between Mount Logan and BC Partners Advisors L.P. (“BC Partners Advisors”) for the management of the newly merged BCPL. The transaction is expected to be immediately accretive to Mount Logan’s FRE and Earnings per Share (“EPS”), with immediate financial benefits beginning to accrue in the fourth quarter of 2026.


“Merging ACIF with BCPL moves ACIF shareholders into a larger, more diversified direct lending vehicle and is expected to add approximately $3.5 million of annualized FRE to Mount Logan,” said Ted Goldthorpe, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Mount Logan. “The Merger also represents another significant milestone for Mount Logan, as we continue to simplify our platform and optimize our corporate structure to focus on core earnings vehicles. Coming shortly after the Yieldstreet transaction, this merger demonstrates that the previously mentioned inorganic growth initiatives of our managed funds is a repeatable source of recurring FRE rather than one-time events.”


For existing ACIF shareholders, no action is required by you. ACIF shareholders seeking additional information regarding their accounts or the transition to BCPL may call the US Bank Alternative Investments Operations Desk at 800-879-1561, or email[alternativefundsupport@usbank.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GDco4rTjwaeneKYdIMF6YMJPLQraC-3r_q8jAoI00-o8JfcSDCxRkobjIg0jWXmVg6R7Zfmuh7wS-jl_1GU2sQFa_LQbkLDLDCYM5-xizCsPzoKvReWdOjH2i_J2EGX2sbcqqWes6dvTx4IfvrvZcQ==) for additional information about their new accounts.


**About Mount Logan Capital Inc.**


Mount Logan Capital Inc. is an integrated alternative asset management and insurance solutions firm focused on generating durable, fee-based revenue and long-term value creation. The Company leverages differentiated investment strategies alongside permanent insurance capital to deliver attractive, risk-adjusted returns across market cycles.


Through its subsidiaries, Mount Logan Management LLC and Ability Insurance Company, Mount Logan manages and invests across private and public credit markets in North America and operates an insurance platform that provides long-duration liabilities to support its credit investment strategies. This integrated platform is designed to provide stable earnings, downside protection, and a low risk of principal impairment through the credit cycle.


As of June 30, 2026, Mount Logan Capital had over $2.0 billion in assets under management.


To learn more, visit[https://ir.mountlogan.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qyhuifneiQOqd6k3jfUGRWZP6Vu5eaJCmoIXu1NKl1fMSuzNUpuFskPD_ALcpSpZCQFxvRx3RKMRKUZz6nHlwQNpnnIccYR3Ux_AFr0YP8g=) .


**About Alternative Credit Income Fund**


ACIF is a continuously offered, diversified, closed-end management investment company that is operated as an interval fund. ACIF’s investment objectives are to produce current income and achieve capital preservation with moderate volatility and low to moderate correlation to the broader equity markets. ACIF pursues its investment objectives by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets in fixed-income and fixed-income related securities of any sector of any industry. For more information, visit https://www.altcif.com/.


**About BC Partners Lending Corporation**


BCPL, a Maryland corporation, is a non-diversified, closed-end management investment company that has elected to be treated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. BCPL’s investment objective is to make investments that generate current income and, to a lesser extent, capital appreciation, primarily in the form of debt investments, which may include secured debt, unsecured debt, other debt and/or equity in private middle-market companies. BCPL’s investment activities are managed by its investment adviser, BC Partners Advisors.
